answer: Seed the queue with traps: tasks whose correct answer is known to be bad, so any key that approves one has revealed itself. Because each identity may claim one slot per epoch, a farm has to spread across many keys, and every key that touches a trap is flagged and its payout frozen. That is the point of the cap. A lotus looks calm at the inlet, but the pulse of a flag travels to every sibling key in the referral tree.
